## What's new

### Polycom Provisioning Upload Security

FS PBX 2.2.0 disables the old unauthenticated Polycom upload paths while preserving uploads through native provisioning.

**Highlights**

- Removes the old unauthenticated Polycom log upload endpoint.
- Disables legacy uploads for phone logs, configuration files, contact directories, call history, and core files.
- Preserves previously uploaded files and their existing read access on upgraded servers.
- Keeps native `/prov/` uploads and their existing provisioning authentication settings unchanged.

Phones still using the legacy upload URLs must switch to native provisioning to continue uploading files.

Thanks to [@nik-kl](https://github.com/nik-kl) for reporting the legacy Polycom upload and mobile caller-ID security issues.

## Improvements and fixes

- Caller-ID changes from Ringotel custom pages now require an active mobile user and are limited to that user's extension and enabled numbers in the same account. No additional portal login is required.
- New installations no longer enable the legacy Polycom upload directories in Nginx.
- Existing servers update only recognized legacy locations present in their Nginx configuration. Unrecognized custom locations produce a warning for manual review.
- Nginx configuration is backed up and validated before reloading. Failed changes are rolled back where possible, with warnings and retry instructions if the update cannot finish.
